input.subject: VPN down - telemedicine offline
input.body: Since 07:40 our clinic VPN drops every connection. EMR integration and telemedicine sessions are failing for all staff. Please help urgently.

reasons.message: High-priority Incident flagged by the classifier and 80% of the precedent vote

precedents.subject: VPN connection drops after firmware update
precedents.answer_snippet: Rolled back the gateway firmware to 4.2.1 and reissued client certificates...
precedents.body: After last night's firmware update our site-to-site VPN drops every few minutes. Remote staff cannot reach internal systems and the clinic portal times out.
precedents.answer: Rolled back the gateway firmware to 4.2.1 and reissued client certificates for all remote users. The tunnel has been stable for 24 hours. If drops return, please send the gateway log export and we will escalate to the network team.

precedents.subject: VPN-Verbindung bricht ständig ab
precedents.answer_snippet: Wir haben die MTU-Einstellungen am Gateway angepasst...
precedents.body: Seit heute Morgen bricht die VPN-Verbindung aller Außendienstmitarbeiter alle paar Minuten ab. Bitte dringend prüfen.
precedents.answer: Wir haben die MTU-Einstellungen am Gateway angepasst und die Keepalive-Intervalle verkürzt. Die Verbindungen sind seitdem stabil. Bitte melden Sie sich, falls die Abbrüche erneut auftreten.
